speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyoderma Gangrenosum. The clinical presentation of a painful, ulcerative lesion with a necrotic base and purplish borders, combined with a blood biopsy showing neutrophilic infiltration without infection and the absence of fever or elevated WBC, is diagnostic. The presence of varicose veins suggests an underlying vascular etiology that likely triggered this neutrophilic dermatosis.
